components.name: Matrix rain
components.description: Matrix rain — animated background of falling characters (2.6 Backgrounds). Decorative only (BGR-01). Tone: Neutral (text tokens + accent pointer), Brand (gradient/brand-* + accent), Classic (black + green, effect/matrix/*, same in Light and Dark). Intensity sets layer opacity and density (Subtle .4 · Default .7 · Intense 1). Charset: Mixed (Latin + Uzbek Cyrillic + digits), Latin, Cyrillic, Digits

Matrix rain.text:
ASSETS · BACKGROUNDS
BEK
Design System
2.6 Backgrounds · Matrix rain
Falling columns of characters with a glow that follows the pointer. Neutral and Brand follow the theme; Classic is the black-and-green look, the same in Light and Dark.
Overview
Three tones × three intensities × four character sets (36 variants). Show pointer toggles the glow.
Neutral
text/primary heads, text/secondary trails, text/disabled noise; pointer accent/default.
Brand
accent/default heads, gradient/brand-end trails, gradient/brand-start noise; pointer accent/active.
Classic
effect/matrix/* — near-black base, green heads and trails. Mode-independent.
Anatomy
Base
Fill — bg/base, or effect/matrix/bg in Classic
Rain
One mono text column per 14 px; layer opacity = intensity
Head · Trail · Noise
Three colour roles per column
Pointer zone
Characters near the pointer switch to the pointer colour
Pointer glow
Blurred ellipse, Show pointer
Intensity
Preset strength. In code every value is a prop; presets are starting points.
Subtle
opacity .4 · density .22 — behind text.
Default
opacity .7 · density .38 — hero.
Intense
opacity 1 · density .55 — cover, 404, loading only.
Charset
Mixed is the default: Latin + Uzbek Cyrillic + digits and symbols. In code charset is any string.
Mixed
Latin
Cyrillic
Digits
Usage
Rules BGR-01 … BGR-06 apply to every background on this page.
Rule
What
Why
BGR-01
Decorative only: aria-hidden, pointer-events none (pointer tracked on window)
Screen readers and clicks ignore it
BGR-02
Text on top passes contrast on the worst frame — add a bg/base gradient scrim when needed
Moving content changes contrast
BGR-03
prefers-reduced-motion → one static frame, no pointer effects
Motion sensitivity
BGR-04
Default 30 fps, pause off-screen or in a hidden tab, devicePixelRatio ≤ 2
Battery and CPU
BGR-05
One animated background per screen
Focus and performance
BGR-06
Never under forms, tables or dense content — hero, auth, onboarding, empty, 404, loading, cover only
Readability
• Charset is a variant in Figma (Mixed, Latin, Cyrillic, Digits) and a free string prop in code — any characters.
• Classic is a strong brand moment: cover, 404, loading. Neutral / Brand for everyday heroes.
• Keep text in a calm area (left / bottom) and the pointer zone away from it.
Devices
Instances resize freely — content scales, edges clip. Keep text in a calm area (BGR-02).
